title: Peculiar Disk Substructures Associated with the Young Eruptive Star EX Lupi
question: Does the disk of the EXor EX Lupi host resolved substructures, and how do they relate to the disk surface/thermal structure and to episodic accretion?

data.bands: Band 3 (92.95 GHz, 3.2 mm) and Band 4 (152.95 GHz, 2.0 mm)
data.angular_resolution: CLEAN beams 0.103"x0.068" (B3), 0.064"x0.042" (B4); PRIISM effective 47x39 mas (B3), 47x35 mas (B4)
data.sensitivity: rms 36 uJy/beam (B3), 46 uJy/beam (B4) in CLEAN images

evidence.quote: has a quiescent stellar luminosity of $0.43~L_{\odot}$ (cite: Wang2023ApJ)
a dynamical stellar mass of $0.5~M_{\odot}$ (cite: hales_circumstellar_2018)

what.value: Flaring index beta = 1.09 from SED fit

evidence.quote: flaring index $\beta (= 1.09)$ determined from a SED fit using a flared disk model (cite: sipos_ex_2009)
obtained with SPHERE at the VLT from (cite: rigliaco_circumstellar_2020)

recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, phase-center shifting with fixvis/fixplanets, phase-only self-cal with CLEAN model
l1+TSV regularized maximum likelihood with 10-fold CV over a grid of (Lambda_l, Lambda_tsv); restored image via beam convolution plus residuals

recipe.goal: Fit outer ring geometry and width
recipe.method: ellipse fit for PA/inclination; Gaussian fit to deprojected radial profile with emcee; deconvolve beam
assumptions: deprojected outer ring is circular; Gaussian ring and beam

recipe.goal: Inner arc elongation and spectral index
recipe.method: PA profile of deprojected arc gives arc length/width; spectral index averaged over pixels >3 sigma in both bands
assumptions: arc coplanar with outer ring (same inclination and PA)

recipe.method: Sobel edge detection on smoothed Q_phi image, ellipse fit with emcee, height from center offset H=Oc/sin(i)
key_parameters: 500 walkers, 2000 steps, 500 burn-in; PA fixed 51.7 deg; Gaussian smoothing FWHM 0.2"

recipe.goal: Temperature profile, scale height, trapping ratio
recipe.method: passively irradiated flared disk energy balance gives T_d(r); h_p=c_s/Omega; ratio of deconvolved width to h_p
assumptions: mu=2.3, M*=0.5 Msun, L*=0.43 Lsun, stellar heating dominant

recipe.method: curve of growth on deprojected Band 4 PRIISM model, radius at 95% of total flux

evidence.quote: are $1.0\pm0.2$ mJy in Band 3 and $2.1\pm0.4$ mJy in Band 4
are $1.0\pm0.2$ mJy in Band 3 and $2.1\pm0.4$ mJy in Band 4
